title: GB domestic EPC record (canonical)
description: One domestic Energy Performance Certificate for Great Britain, mapped from a source dataset (see schemas/mappings/). Values are typed; every field is present and is null when the source has no value.

source_dataset.description: Source dataset the record came from (path under schemas/source/).

country.description: Country of the property. England and Wales are told apart by the local authority code.

certificate_id.description: Certificate identifier: CERTIFICATE_NUMBER (England and Wales) or REPORT_REFERENCE_NUMBER (Scotland).

uprn.description: Unique Property Reference Number (Scotland: OSG reference number).

lodgement_date.description: Date the certificate was lodged on the register.

lodged_at.description: Date and time the certificate was lodged (ISO 8601, no time zone).

superseded.description: True if a newer certificate exists for the property. Known for Scotland; null for England and Wales, which publishes superseded certificates without a flag.

address_line_1.description: First address line (Royal Mail / OS licence terms apply).

address_line_2.description: Second address line (Royal Mail / OS licence terms apply).

post_town.description: Post town (Royal Mail / OS licence terms apply).

postcode.description: Postcode (Royal Mail / OS licence terms apply).

local_authority_name.description: Local authority name as published by the source.

tenure.description: Tenure, lower case; 'rental' spellings normalised to 'rented'.

construction_age_band.description: Construction age band exactly as the source labels it (England and Wales prefix removed). Bands differ between nations; use construction_year_min/max to compare.

construction_year_min.description: First year of the construction age band; null if open-ended or unknown.

construction_year_max.description: Last year of the construction age band; null if open-ended or unknown.

total_floor_area.description: Total floor area in square metres.

main_fuel.description: Main heating fuel as described by the source (English part only).

glazed_type.description: Glazing type as described by the source.

main_heating_description.description: Description of the main heating system (first element and English part only).

main_heating_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the main heating system (first element).

main_heating_controls_description.description: Description of the main heating controls (first element and English part only).

main_heating_controls_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the main heating controls (first element).

hot_water_description.description: Description of the hot water system (first element and English part only).

hot_water_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the hot water system (first element).

walls_description.description: Description of the walls (first element and English part only).

walls_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the walls (first element).

roof_description.description: Description of the roof (first element and English part only).

roof_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the roof (first element).

floor_description.description: Description of the floor (first element and English part only).

floor_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the floor (first element).

windows_description.description: Description of the windows (first element and English part only).

windows_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the windows (first element).

lighting_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency rating of the lighting (first element).

has_solar_pv.description: True if solar photovoltaic panels are recorded.

has_solar_water_heating.description: True if solar water heating is recorded.

co2_emissions_current.description: Current CO2 emissions, tonnes per year. Can be negative where on-site generation exceeds use.

heating_cost_current.description: Current space heating cost, GBP per year (Scottish 3-year figures divided by 3).

hot_water_cost_current.description: Current hot water cost, GBP per year (Scottish 3-year figures divided by 3).

lighting_cost_current.description: Current lighting cost, GBP per year (Scottish 3-year figures divided by 3).
